_comment: 報告ステージ「バグ報告ゲーム」の 説明ページ（2026-09-23 の 指定「画像を作って視覚的にわかりやすい内容に」）。元は bug_report/index.html の 3ステップ（使う・見つける・報告する）。 2026-09-23 R9検収: 表紙・手順1・2の絵が1問目（フード注文）のバグそのものを見せていたので、教材に無い天気の画面に描き直した（元の README「表紙にはバグの内容を書いていません」）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. This one is a teaching diagram: few large elements, generous spacing, each label sitting on a soft cream panel with a rounded border, arranged so the eye reads it in one pass.
noText: Japanese lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the Japanese words listed in the scene above (and the few short screen values quoted there), and no other writing at all. Print each Japanese word LARGE and horizontally in a rounded gothic Japanese font, with generous space around it. Directly above every kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height, so that the kanji and the furigana both stay sharp and easy to read at a glance. Words written only in hiragana or katakana take no furigana. Spell every character exactly as given. No other letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots.

scenes.title: 表紙：テスターが Webサイトを テストする
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: you are the tester — you use a website that a programmer made, and look carefully for things that do not work. A young Southeast Asian IT student in their early twenties (the tester), neat short dark hair, light sky-blue polo shirt, friendly focused face. sits at a desk in a bright office, seen from a three-quarter angle, one hand on the mouse, leaning in toward a large monitor. The monitor FILLS a big part of the frame and shows a simple WEATHER web page: a city name 'Tokyo' at the top and a row of five day cards, each with a weather icon (sun, cloud, rain) and a temperature like '24°'. A big friendly cartoon ladybug-shaped 'bug' (a cute round beetle, clearly a symbol, not scary) peeks out from behind one of the day cards, and the tester has noticed it with a curious 'hmm?' face. On the desk: a notepad and a pen. In the background, blurred, a programmer colleague types at another desk. Label panels: テスター near the tester, プログラマー near the colleague. Screen values allowed: 'Tokyo', '24°', '22°', '19°'. No food, no shopping cart, no forms.

scenes.title: 1. 使う
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: step 1 — really use the website: click buttons and type, like a real user. Close-up from over the shoulder of A young Southeast Asian IT student in their early twenties (the tester), neat short dark hair, light sky-blue polo shirt, friendly focused face. at a laptop. The laptop screen fills most of the frame and shows a simple WEATHER web page with two big city tabs 'Tokyo' and 'Osaka' at the top and one large weather card below (a sun icon and '24°'). The tester's finger clicks the 'Osaka' tab; a small click-ripple shows the press. A soft cream label panel at the top of the picture reads 使う. Screen values allowed: 'Tokyo', 'Osaka', '24°'. No food, no shopping cart, no plus or minus buttons.

scenes.title: 2. 見つける
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: step 2 — notice something strange: the words and the picture on the screen do not match. Close-up of a laptop screen filling the frame, showing a WEATHER card: the city 'Osaka', the big word 'Sunny', and next to it a big RAIN CLOUD icon with falling raindrops (not a sun). The rain cloud icon is circled with a thick coral-red hand-drawn circle, and a big question mark floats next to it. In the lower corner, the face of A young Southeast Asian IT student in their early twenties (the tester), neat short dark hair, light sky-blue polo shirt, friendly focused face. looks surprised and puzzled. A soft cream label panel at the top of the picture reads 見つける. Screen values allowed: 'Osaka', 'Sunny', '24°'. No food, no shopping cart, no prices.

scenes.title: 3. 報告する
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: step 3 — report the bug in 4 parts, in this order: which screen, what you did, what happened, what should happen. A young Southeast Asian IT student in their early twenties (the tester), neat short dark hair, light sky-blue polo shirt, friendly focused face. stands on the left and speaks politely to an older Japanese programmer colleague (short hair, glasses, navy cardigan) sitting at a desk on the right, who listens and nods. Between them, large and in the centre, floats a big cream report card with four numbered rows, top to bottom, each row a rounded box with a small icon: row 1 a screen icon with the words どの画面, row 2 a pointing-finger click icon with 何をしたか, row 3 an exclamation icon with どうなったか, row 4 a check-mark lightbulb icon with 本当は どうなるか. Circled numbers 1 to 4 at the left of each row. A soft cream label panel at the top of the picture reads 報告する.
text: 本当は どうなるか
